latest.name: Claude Opus 4.8
latest.headline: Anthropic's most capable model yet — better coding, reasoning, and honesty.
highlights: Agentic coding score up from 64.3% to 69.2%
~4× less likely to let a code flaw pass without comment
Fast mode runs at 2.5× speed and 3× cheaper than before
Dynamic workflows: hundreds of parallel subagents in Claude Code

timeline.title: Introducing Claude Corps
timeline.summary: Claude Corps is a national fellowship for early-career people passionate about extending the benefits of AI to communities across America.

timeline.title: Anthropic expands to India with Bengaluru office
timeline.summary: Anthropic will open a Bengaluru office in early 2026, its second APAC location, and improve Claude's support for major Indic languages.

timeline.title: Expanding our use of Google Cloud TPUs
timeline.summary: Announcing a dramatic increase in Anthropic's compute resources through an expanded partnership with Google Cloud.

timeline.title: Working with the US Department of Energy
timeline.summary: A multi-year partnership with the DOE's Genesis Mission deploys Claude and custom scientific tools across the 17 national laboratories.

timeline.title: National Security and Public Sector Advisory Council
timeline.summary: Eleven former senators and senior defense, intelligence, and energy officials will help identify high-impact AI applications for US security.

timeline.title: Anthropic brings AI education to Africa with Rwanda and ALX
timeline.summary: A Claude-based learning companion reaches Rwandan teachers and 200,000+ ALX students across Africa.

timeline.title: Salesforce and Anthropic expand partnership
timeline.summary: Claude becomes a preferred model in Salesforce's Agentforce for regulated industries.

timeline.title: Seoul becomes Anthropic's third APAC office
timeline.summary: Anthropic will open a Seoul office in early 2026 as APAC run-rate revenue grows over 10x and Korean enterprises adopt Claude.

timeline.title: Snowflake and Anthropic announce $200M partnership
timeline.summary: A multi-year partnership brings Claude to Snowflake's 12,600+ customers to deploy AI agents across regulated industries.

timeline.title: Dario Amodei on American AI leadership
timeline.summary: A statement from Anthropic CEO, Dario Amodei, on Anthropic’s commitment to advancing America's leadership in building powerful and beneficial AI

timeline.title: Strengthening safeguards with US CAISI and UK AISI
timeline.summary: Government red-teamers tested Constitutional Classifiers on Claude Opus 4 and 4.1, uncovering vulnerabilities that strengthened our safeguards.

timeline.title: Updates to Consumer Terms and Privacy Policy
timeline.summary: Claude Free, Pro, and Max users can now opt in to having conversations used to improve models, with a five-year retention period for participants.

timeline.title: Updating sales restrictions for unsupported regions
timeline.summary: Anthropic is tightening restrictions to bar entities majority-owned by companies headquartered in unsupported regions.

timeline.title: Rahul Patil joins as Chief Technology Officer
timeline.summary: Rahul Patil brings 20+ years of infrastructure experience from Stripe, AWS, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud to lead engineering at Anthropic.

timeline.title: Protecting the wellbeing of our users
timeline.summary: New safeguards include a crisis classifier that routes users to 170+ helplines worldwide and models that are far less sycophantic.

timeline.title: Measuring political bias in Claude
timeline.summary: We introduce and open-source an automated evaluation for political even-handedness, testing six models across 1,350 prompt pairs.

timeline.title: Anthropic opens Tokyo office
timeline.summary: Anthropic opens its first Asia-Pacific office in Tokyo and signs a Memorandum of Cooperation with the Japan AI Safety Institute.

timeline.title: New offices in Paris and Munich
timeline.summary: Anthropic opens offices in Paris and Munich as EMEA becomes its fastest-growing region, with run-rate revenue up 9x in the past year.

timeline.title: Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Anthropic partnerships
timeline.summary: Anthropic commits $30B to Azure compute as NVIDIA and Microsoft invest up to $15B combined, bringing Claude to all three major clouds.

timeline.title: Maryland partners with Anthropic to serve residents
timeline.summary: Maryland is deploying Claude across state agencies for benefits applications, document processing, and workforce upskilling.

upcoming.title: Claude Opus 4.9 / 5.0
upcoming.summary: Expected next flagship step. Watch for larger effort-control range and deeper agent orchestration.

upcoming.title: Expanded dynamic workflows
upcoming.summary: Parallel subagent orchestration expanding beyond Enterprise/Team/Max in Claude Code.

upcoming.title: Longer context tier
upcoming.summary: Competitive pressure from 2M-token rivals; a larger context option is plausible.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.note: Best-in-class agentic coding and the most reliable at flagging its own mistakes. The reference point for this comparison.

models.name: GPT-5.5
models.note: Strongest all-rounder; broad ecosystem and tooling. Slightly pricier on input than Claude.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.note: Leads published reasoning benchmarks and is the fastest of the group. Cheapest output among the frontier tier.

models.name: Grok 4
models.note: Largest context window at 2M tokens; strong raw coding scores.

models.name: DeepSeek V4-Pro
models.note: By far the cheapest frontier option — open-weight MoE, ~1.6T params. Great cost-to-performance.

models.name: Llama 4 Maverick
models.note: Open weights, self-hostable. Lower benchmark scores but unbeatable on price and control.

models.name: Mistral Large 3
models.note: European, strong on efficiency and multilingual tasks. Smaller context window than rivals.
